title: Slide the price

predict.q: A firm sells 100 units and its average cost is 9. Its price falls from 12 to 9. What is it earning now?

options.s: A loss of 900, because all of its revenue goes on costs
options.fb: Costs include normal profit. When AR = AC the owners' opportunity cost is covered, so nothing is lost.

options.s: Normal profit: its owners do as well as in their next-best use
options.fb: AR = AC: all costs, including the owners' opportunity costs, are covered.

options.s: Nothing at all, so it should close now
options.fb: Zero economic profit means normal profit: the owners do as well here as anywhere else. There is no reason to leave.
Profit per unit is AR − AC = 9 − 9 = 0. The rectangle has no height.

task: Move the **price** slider from 12 down to 5 and watch the profit rectangle shrink, vanish and turn into a loss.

target.do: Move the price slider down to 9 or below, then press Check.

takeaway: P above ATC: positive economic profit. P = ATC: zero economic profit (normal profit). P below ATC: an economic loss.
